children: Made-in-India 15-inch tyre gets new white-letter design, with larger locally produced sizes planned for 2027
Yokohama India has introduced a white-letter version of its GEOLANDAR A/T tyre as the company expands its locally produced range for SUVs and utility vehicles.

The 15-inch GEOLANDAR A/T is now available in India with an Outline White Letter design. The company said the new styling is aimed at SUV owners looking for a more distinctive appearance, while retaining the tyre’s all-terrain positioning.
The GEOLANDAR A/T was previously available in India through imports but is now being manufactured at Yokohama India’s facility in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
The 15-inch white-letter version is currently available in two sizes. Yokohama India plans to expand the locally produced range to 16-inch, 17-inch and 18-inch sizes in 2027.
The tyre is suited to several SUVs and utility vehicles, including the Maruti Suzuki Jimny and Mahindra Bolero, according to the company.

The move also marks a shift from the tyre being primarily an imported product to being manufactured locally. Yokohama India said local production will support the expansion of the product range in the Indian market.
The white-letter treatment is designed to make the tyre more visible on the vehicle, adding contrast to the sidewall and giving SUVs a more rugged appearance.

Gaurav Mahajan, Head of Marketing and OE Sales, Yokohama India, said SUV ownership is increasingly linked to lifestyle and personal expression, with customers looking for vehicles that reflect their interest in adventure and outdoor driving.

The company’s move comes as SUVs and utility vehicles continue to form an important part of the Indian passenger vehicle market, creating demand for tyres that combine everyday use with an all-terrain design.

Yokohama India, part of Japan’s Yokohama Rubber Co., supplies tyres for passenger cars, SUVs, commercial vehicles and other applications. It has manufacturing facilities in New Delhi and Visakhapatnam.

With the GEOLANDAR A/T now being produced domestically and larger sizes planned for next year, Yokohama India is looking to broaden its presence in the SUV tyre segment while increasing the share of locally manufactured products in its portfolio.
